Name: Seraiah, Son of Kenaz
Summary: Son of Kenaz and father of Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:13: Son of Kenaz and father of Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Seraiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
